summary: Fresh latest-HEAD B-even continuation skips QA-pending B00152/index152 and advances C126-released index112 D41D0B1. The exact canonical 2048x256 DXT5 source is reused from the unchanged C126 fingerprint. Full-canvas BC3 alpha analysis resolves B00148's unsafe-boundary blocker: the exact source has 132,035 alpha-positive pixels in exactly seven 8-connected components, every component intersects the bright English glyph seed, and no other alpha-positive/non-text component exists. The previous hard limit omitted 29 effect pixels and clipped the true effect by one pixel on right/bottom. The full alpha effect is therefore materialized as the removal mask; original alpha==0 pixels are the protected mask. An exact-resolution CLEAN_PLATE is produced by deterministic hidden-RGB diffusion from immutable alpha==0 source pixels and setting only removal-mask alpha to zero; it leaves 0 changed protected pixels and 0 alpha-positive pixels. A first bright-core-only attempt was visually rejected before commit because navy outline/shadow remained. Source style is also measured: white core, dark navy outline/shadow family, flip_y raw transform, and robust right slant with median stable-stem angle about +15 degrees. No Korean DDS/shared state/build/runtime/N100/Drive/local-clone/Library/VR/FFB/DX changes.
